cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requires dismissal, A3 controls the next arrangement, and A5 permits sitting in the taxi while withholding departure approval.

relationship.evidence: B2 has completed the till and B4 supplies family transport urgency, credibly seeking release from a closed shop.

heightening.evidence: B4 solves the staying arrangement, so A5 moves the permission gate into the vehicle instead of ending it.
